note: Minimal C9-style context table, co-designed with the zh sidecar golden fixtures (issue #19, per its plan review). `singles` is the committed C3 definition — the v0 sliver function-word subset admitted as pinned single tokens (issue #19 step 2(a) parenthetical: {的, 了, 不, 一} plus 嗎/呢). `entries` enumerates the (prev, char, next) role-contexts the fixtures exercise, each carrying the curation-pinned base reading and the resolver-verified surface reading for that context. The sidecar leg is FAIL-CLOSED: any single occurring in a context absent from this enumeration regenerates. 呢 is C3-admitted but carries no entry (no fixture exercises it), so every 呢 occurrence regenerates — fail-closed, per the AC. #20 owns the real C9 enumeration (all in-world neighbor bigrams/trigrams, jury/native-assisted) and replaces this file wholesale.

contextMarkers.meaning: prev/next are the adjacent unit surfaces inside the same Han run; a run boundary (start/end of run, or adjacent punctuation) is <START>/<END>.

entries.note: perfective aspect marker after verb, before object
negation before third tone — no 不 shift (shift applies before 4th tone only)
weekday ordinal — 一 stays unshifted yī; the ordinal/date hard rule requires exactly this rule marker
一 shifts to yí before 4th tone (個 gè)
